newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar closes in range, business light.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar closes in range, business light.

text.p: London white sugar futures held their established ranges at the close on Wednesday after profit-taking on the spot March contract offset earlier mixed buying, traders said.
Outright trade and commission house buyers provided most of the overall volume, which totalled a scant 646 lots on the March contract by the close.

March and May both closed down $0.20 at $303.70 and $304.40 respectively. Traders said the nearby contango could easily continue for some time as heavy supply weighed down on the spot month. May turned over 81 lots.
"There is a lot of sugar around and it (the weakness) is just a continuation of that," said one trader.
"It might go back up a little but overall, I think March will come off underneath May," he said.
The London whites market is expected to be quiet to the end of the week on account of New York's two-day closure for the Thanksgiving holiday.
London will close at 1700 GMT on Thursday and Friday.
Activity in Paris was dominated by the spot March contract, which was unchanged at $303.40. May was 20 cents lower at $304.20 and Matif turnover amounted to 597 lots.
